status: Revision 2026-09-25: rerun of the 2026-09-15 protocol on the re-digitized Fig. 3 (data/zhang_kojima_1998_fig3_redigitized.csv). Models, laws, bounds, budgets, seeds and scoring are unchanged; only the input histograms, the class convention and the held-out set (genuine histograms only) differ. Fixed before any new fit was run.
training: Eight post-initial Fig. 3 histograms from 3-klx preculture (days 4 and 16 at V_L = 5/25/50/100 %), equal mean TV weight per histogram.
test: Nine post-initial Fig. 3 histograms from 10-klx preculture (days 5 and 18 at all four V_L; day 25 at V_L = 100 % only, the only day-25 series in the source). No model, daughter law, hyperparameter or starting state selected using these errors.
scalar_check: Fig. 5 post-initial D30 of the same runs (the re-digitization shows Figs. 3 and 5 report the same cultures), same histogram initialization and frozen parameters; paired scalar validation including days without histograms (3 klx: 8, 12, 21; 10 klx: 9, 13, 25). Not a fit objective.
common_growth: Gx=3*0.055*I/(0.70+I)*x; I in original detector volts, prescribed from biomass.
mechanical_rate: 0.020*S(D;Dc), equal-material binary, shared gate within each fit.
state_inheritance: Homogeneous state inherited by all descendants; exact marginal reduction, no state reset.
nested_seed: For instantaneous and finite_time, the final global candidate is the same-scenario/law fitted simpler model embedded with eta=0 or tau=0, respectively. It uses training information only and counts within the 512 budget.
training_refinement: Batched coordinate polls in normalized log b, log Dc, eta and log(1+tau/0.25); start from best global candidate; initial step .125, halve after unsuccessful poll. Exactly 128 evaluations, all training-only.
sensitivity_budget: Same 512 global plus 128 local per model and law as primary.
grid: Eight subdivisions per observed class; first class geometric from 0.0001 mm to its upper edge; other classes log-spaced within exact class edges; geometric upper extension to at least 1.2 mm.
initial_within_bin: Uniform number density in diameter, exactly reaggregates to each observed initial histogram; no smoothing across observed bins.
exterior_probability: Retained in a scored overflow category, never renormalized away.

reconstruction_scenarios.primary: Re-digitized raw marker frequencies, renormalized to 100 % per histogram.
reconstruction_scenarios.shift_left: Move 10% of every bin probability to its left neighbor, retain mass at lower boundary; every initial and later histogram.
reconstruction_scenarios.shift_right: Move 10% to the right neighbor, retain mass at upper observed boundary; every initial and later histogram.
reconstruction_scenarios.broaden: Move 10% to each neighbor, reflecting at observed boundaries; every initial and later histogram.
reconstruction_scenarios.tail_up: Multiply bin probabilities by exp(0.25*(D/0.30-1)) and renormalize; every initial and later histogram.
reconstruction_scenarios.tail_down: Multiply bin probabilities by exp(-0.25*(D/0.30-1)) and renormalize; every initial and later histogram.
reconstruction_scenarios.bins_minus_0p011: Primary frequencies with every class edge shifted by -0.011 mm.

sensitivity_scope: Declared stress tests of extraction/shape and class-convention uncertainty, not estimated digitization errors, sampling draws or confidence intervals.
numerical_checks: Independent no-event analytic growth transport, event number/material/support, exact initialization, neutral/instantaneous limits, frozen-fit dt/2, double and quadruple grid, expanded domain; primary finest-grid refit if numerical error prevents interpretation.
bin_convention: Source classes undefined. Primary: marker positions 0, 0.05, ..., 0.55 mm are class representatives; class edges 0, 0.025, 0.075, ..., 0.575 mm. Sensitivity 'bins_minus_0p011': all edges shifted by -0.011 mm (best common shift reproducing Fig. 5 D30).
